scope: Sweep allocations reached inside the AC1024 OBJECTS callback while emitting typed base, value, and geometry associative dependency records.

source.profile: The base dependency profile has class version 3, status -7, read/attached flags, dependency order -2, present name allocation-retry, null dependency references, and body id -9. The value-dependency profile adds class version 0, name VALUE_DEPENDENCY, and a real value 12.5. The geometry profile adds class version 0, enabled state, AcDbAssocSingleEdgePersSubentId, and dependent-on-compound-object state; dependency references and subentity indices remain null/default.

implementation.method: Warm and calibrate each record profile in ASCII and Binary. Inject std::bad_alloc at every reached callback offset; require failed whole-file publication, byte-identical destination sentinel preservation, caller-object preservation, same-codec retry, and fresh DXF typed readback of the base, value, and geometry dependency fields.

validation.ascii: Base dependency: 6/6; value dependency: 8/8; geometry dependency: 8/8 callback allocation offsets injected. Destination and source were preserved; same-codec retry and typed readback passed.
validation.binary: Base dependency: 6/6; value dependency: 7/7; geometry dependency: 7/7 callback allocation offsets injected. Destination and source were preserved; same-codec retry and typed readback passed.

limitations: Generated serialization and transaction evidence only; no physical producer prevalence or native associative semantics are established.

The value dependency control covers only one AC1024 real-valued profile; integer values remain outside scope. Geometry coverage is limited to a generated default-index SingleEdge profile and does not establish source prevalence, reference graph closure, or native geometry semantics.
nextAction: Extend associative dependency allocation coverage to non-null, source-backed reference roles within a rooted graph; preserve strict source/graph closure and semantic gates.
